description: favourites = the 28 sessions saved on ideasfest.uk (IDs from the ?plan= link). added = sessions vedrí curation put in on top. curation = per-session verdict. The Plan tab's Route view shows core + booked commitments, plus good sessions that don't clash with them.

high-potential-scalable-businesses.why: Investor-minded framing of a scalable business, on the morning of your final. Most-hearted; go early.

ce30f8bf-f8d2-4e78-aae8-f50856682b7f.why: Fine 30-minute opener if Real Talk is rammed. Same slot as High Potential.

henry-engelhardt-good-boss.why: Great founder, but leadership at Admiral scale is a year-two problem for vedrí.

377c0e4d-1a53-4465-b74f-a8a23d6cd046.why: Exit talk. You are opening a second studio, not selling the first.

da669c1d-0231-4782-88a3-84d01c86e881.why: Eats the whole morning. Better spent on High Potential then Getting Heard.

9d6f53ce-e478-47b3-b06f-7b6cbbcd0f78.why: Coaching-room session clashes with Getting Heard.

94732b16-9ba5-4cd2-a93f-adb08c82c281.why: Cut-through marketing for a studio nobody has heard of yet. Most-hearted of the week.

8a4f052a-0149-4f51-baa9-090aaebaeda1.why: Confidence and speaking up: useful before the 17:00 final, but Getting Heard is the better use of 11:00.

15-minute-money-routine.why: Bookkeeping routine. Clashes with Getting Heard.

master-talking-to-strangers.why: Clashes with Getting Heard; you already talk to strangers for a living.

560f6a1d-f651-4a18-ad24-1309634e0a62.why: Practical AI for the admin side of a two-person studio. Slip out at 12:25 to make the Big Festoon.

five-new-clients-30-days.why: The single most useful session for vedrí this autumn: client acquisition. Most-hearted of the whole festival, so arrive by 12:20.

9a9c09e6-5586-42a8-b50a-58468db0c438.why: Simon Squibb's keynote clashes with '5 new clients'. Pick the clients talk; catch Squibb's crowd at HelpBnk Live on Thursday.

1ed256a6-1baf-4757-b862-4a1c2b65222d.why: Repeats Thursday 13:00, which is the better slot for you.

3d8a3ee7-b206-4400-a69a-f66f85bfa6fa.why: Hour-long mindset deep dive in your busiest window.

personal-brand-corporate-clients.why: Corporate clients through a founder's personal brand: exactly the LinkedIn-to-shoot pipeline in the vedrí marketing plan.

ad7b57c8-d223-4a56-8097-72f260832b44.why: Woodroffe on brand memorability is fun, but the corporate-clients talk is the money one at 13:00.

fbca0698-d75b-4385-bc36-d1fed997d4e8.why: Watch two or three pitches at 13:45 for tips before your own, then head to the sauna.

great-british-build-off.why: You forwarded this to Aled to do remotely. Left out of the route; if you do build, it's 13:30–15:00 and eats the sauna.

zoky-sauna-reset.why: Booked and paid. A 45-minute reset two hours before the final is a good call. Swimwear, two towels, waiver signed.

be-impossible-to-ignore.why: Brand cut-through, most-hearted. Clashes with the sauna: the alternative if you skip the plunge.

6fa0e7fc-2e4f-43c2-861a-60410d345a4a.why: Systems for running a business without you: relevant to a second studio, but it clashes with the sauna.

17705f2d-9086-4123-a9eb-d988dc006c95.why: Sales automation for teams; you don't have a sales team yet.

1f7591a6-ec8c-4438-8160-40688d9ab9cb.why: You're raising. Join for the last 15 minutes after the sauna and stay for questions.

simon-nicholls-sustainability-strategy.why: General strategy talk; low relevance today.

6825edb7-c19b-445f-ab54-8bf77bdabcb6.why: Deal negotiation is relevant once there's a term sheet. 'Are you investable?' at 15:30 is the priority.

d4e1fab1-06f7-44bf-ad45-79fa6b8e8a64.why: Investment readiness and what a cash injection does. This is your second-studio question, 90 minutes before the final.

d6c6f1b0-06f5-4d3e-94f2-315b3bdbb4fb.why: Clashes with getting to the big top for your final.

uk-startup-awards-national-final.why: Your final. Be at the Conversations That Matter big top by 16:30.

d732386f-0769-4f82-af34-ea0704506090.why: Referral party straight after the awards. Best networking hour of the festival, with a finalist story to open with.

after-dark-wed.why: You're camping on site. The fire pits are where the follow-ups happen.

1c1423bd-4af2-4d4f-9201-85ed9505869f.why: Nine concrete jobs to hand to AI. Directly useful for a small studio's admin and marketing.

4c57f395-39f4-4b9d-acef-d3ac54582b50.why: Good AMA but it clashes with the AI Den session.

460aa0bb-c8b7-4636-becc-4f36360e4739.why: Clashes with the AI Den; scaling-fast problems are not vedrí's yet.

9d893f7b-d05b-47cd-ac50-f63458ab2640.why: Alex Packham built ContentCal for exactly the marketers vedrí sells to, sold it, and is going again. Founder, client insight and investment in one.

6fc9272d-80d8-4662-a87e-8b981c7304a8.why: Greg Jackson is the big-name draw in the same slot. If Real Talk is full, this is the fallback, and Ideas Fest recommended it to you.

e5302c04-87e9-4a25-8be4-21a6e409d9df.why: Stage presence is useful on camera, but it clashes with Packham and Jackson.

6eb3ed92-4c6a-49bf-8cd3-5fe5aac1fe47.why: Dreamland funding session clashes with the 11:00 conversations.

b0e293b7-fa0a-40ce-8aff-3eb837e41854.why: Choosing the right investor for the second studio, not just any cheque.

raising-to-grow.why: Most-hearted funding session. Clashes with 'The Right Money'; catch the second half in the Deal Room.

86aa253d-70ac-4ce5-8b7f-b36615108510.why: Worth it only if the Wednesday was as long as it looks. Otherwise 'The Right Money'.

09fed126-4591-40ce-9bcf-9ee6e5b677af.why: HelpBnk Live: bring one specific ask (a client intro, a creator collab) and vedrí gets in front of Squibb's audience.

4c3f3d8e-4260-411e-854e-b7a46d5bff28.why: What growth costs, useful for the second-studio model. Clashes with HelpBnk Live.

8dd3d9f1-033a-4a47-86bb-7a212d71a64e.why: Thea Green on building a consumer brand. Brand founders are vedrí clients.

6646ae56-b6a8-4ae5-b0f3-fff9a46a8149.why: Fame plus founder is talent-led brand content, a shoot type vedrí wants.

d8079a97-441f-45e9-8457-ddb87b0d32dd.why: Leadership conversations; clashes with the Sweet Spot Show.

d2df5999-b644-41f5-bd71-79eccdc328ef.why: Priestley's repeatable weekly marketing routine. Take this home and run it.

great-british-build-off-final.why: Only if your app is in the top six after the vote.

after-dark-thu.why: DJ Fat Tony. Ask Frankie about that guest slot on the decks.

profile.who: vedrí — North Wales' first virtual production studio, at DocShed, Gwynedd. Real-time green-screen compositing in-house, LED volumes hired in. Founder and studio director Daniel Parry Evans. UK StartUp Awards 2026 national finalist (Wales).
goals: Win brand, agency and creator clients for VP shoots: podcasts, corporate, commercials
Find an investor for a second studio (pitch deck: vedri.studio/vedri-pitch-deck)
Sharpen positioning and a repeatable marketing routine for a capacity-limited studio
Hand admin, follow-up and content jobs to AI
Leave with introductions, not just notes: referral party Wednesday, fire pits both nights
